annotations.text:
Boarding wall — the cabinet elevation as the room board.

Rooms are buttons: click a tile to open it in the rail. The date strip repaints the wall for any of the next 14 days, which is what merges /rooms and the daily calendar question into one screen.

Geometry is DATA (zone + col/row/span), not a traced drawing — so a refit is a drag, not a deploy.

41 boarding units + 6 staging cubbies, read off the blueprint:
Z1 10 (irregular, two double-height ends) · Z2 9 (3x3) · Z3 18 (6x3) · Z4 4 (2x2) · staging 6.

The demo database currently holds 61 placeholder rooms — reconciling those is Question 2 in the plan.

Phone is the primary device on the floor. Zone tabs rather than 41 tiles at once; every target 44pt+.

No fake status bar — the real one renders on top.
